response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack developer with 20+ years of experience, but he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's mandatory requirements. He has only ~6 months of professional C++ experience (versus 5-10 years required) with no Windows platform exposure, and his primary expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js and web technologies. Additionally, he demonstrates no capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or derivatives experience. While talented overall, he would require extensive foundational retraining in C++, Windows systems programming, financial domain knowledge, and SQL Server/Oracle rather than providing ready-to-contribute expertise in critical capital markets systems.
strengths: Extensive 20+ years of software development experience across multiple languages, platforms, and domains demonstrates strong foundational programming skills and adaptability
Proven CI/CD and infrastructure expertise with GitLab, Docker, and deployment automation; demonstrates systems thinking in complex technical environments
Strong communication and knowledge-sharing abilities demonstrated through public talks, workshops, and well-documented open-source contributions
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience (2014-2015) versus the mandatory 5-10 years required; primary expertise is TypeScript/Node.js and web technologies, not systems programming

Zero demonstrated experience in capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking; vague reference to 'investment practices' at RIDE Capital does not evidence required financial domain expertise
No evidence of Windows platform development experience; extensive background on Linux, web-based systems, and cloud platforms but not the required Windows systems environment
